subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Answer trivia questions about famous facts
Form the past passive: was/were + past participle
Change active sentences into the passive

tf.s: Romeo and Juliet was written by William Shakespeare.
tf.why: Yes! Shakespeare wrote many famous plays.

tf.s: The city of Pompeii was destroyed by a volcano.
tf.why: Right! The volcano destroyed the city.

tf.s: The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece.
The past passive is formed with 'was/were' + past participle.
'Edison invented the bulb' is a passive sentence.
tf.why: It is active; the passive is 'The bulb was invented by Edison'.

tf.s: We use the passive when we don't know who did the action.
tf.why: Yes! 'Three paintings were stolen' – we don't know who stole them.

tf.s: Potatoes were first grown by South Americans.
tf.why: Right! This is the passive of 'South Americans first grew potatoes'.

tf.s: The Titanic was sunk by a storm.
tf.why: The Titanic was sunk by an iceberg.

tf.s: In a passive sentence, 'by' introduces the person or thing that did the action.
tf.why: Yes! 'by Shakespeare' tells us who wrote it.

boxes.q: Who was Romeo and Juliet written by?
How was the city of Pompeii destroyed?
Where were the first modern Olympic Games held?
boxes.why: They were held in Athens, Greece.

boxes.q: Complete: Julius Caesar was ___ by Shakespeare.

o: The bulb was invented by Edison.

boxes.q: What is the past participle of 'build'?
Why is the passive used in 'Three paintings were stolen from the museum'?
o: we don't know who stole them
Dynamite was invented by Alfred Nobel.
Dynamite were invented by Alfred Nobel.
boxes.why: Move the object to the front.
The Taj Mahal was designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahauri.

mcq.q: How is the past passive formed?
Why do we say 'My brother was born in Muscat'?
o: We use was + born for the place or date of birth

mcq.why: Potatoes were first grown by South Americans.

mcq.q: What are the passive verbs in the quiz questions?
o: was destroyed, was written, was sent

mcq.q: Rewrite: An iceberg sank the Titanic.
o: The Titanic was sunk by an iceberg.
The Titanic was sank by an iceberg.
An iceberg was sunk by the Titanic.

mcq.q: Rewrite: Ustad Ahmad Lahauri designed the Taj Mahal.
o: The Taj Mahal was designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahauri.
The Taj Mahal designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahauri.
Ustad Ahmad Lahauri was designed the Taj Mahal.
The Taj Mahal were designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahauri.
mcq.why: Object first, then was + past participle, then by + agent.

mcq.q: Rewrite: Tim Berners-Lee invented the world wide web.
o: The world wide web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee.
The world wide web invented Tim Berners-Lee.
The world wide web is invent by Tim Berners-Lee.
Tim Berners-Lee was invented by the world wide web.
mcq.why: The thing invented becomes the subject.

mcq.q: What do 'was destroyed' and 'was written' have in common?
o: Both are past passive: was + past participle

mcq.q: Which sentence best uses the passive because the agent is unknown?
o: My car was stolen last night.
mcq.why: We don't know who stole the car.

mcq.q: Rewrite: Marie Curie discovered radium and Alfred Nobel invented dynamite.
o: Radium was discovered by Marie Curie and dynamite was invented by Alfred Nobel.
Radium discovered Marie Curie and dynamite invented Alfred Nobel.
Radium was discover by Marie Curie and dynamite was invent by Alfred Nobel.
Marie Curie was discovered by radium and Alfred Nobel by dynamite.
mcq.why: Each part needs was + past participle + by.
